purpose: Pre-Stage-B measurement-protocol correction; inference-only standardized rebenchmark of the seven frozen Phase 1 representatives.
historical_preservation: Historical discovery, confirmation, deployment, and Phase 1 smoke measurements remain unchanged. This artifact registers a new stabilized comparison.

protocol.headline_summary: median of all 30 stabilized synchronized-wall-clock decode repetitions; maximum is diagnostic only
protocol.measured_block_gate: each pass also requires its first and second five-measurement blocks to satisfy the same 2% median-drift and 5% CV rule
protocol.failure_policy: a pass or model that does not stabilize is explicitly unresolved and has no canonical throughput value

workload.selection_rationale: Phase 1 protected headline workload; the timing protocol is corrected without changing the frozen Phase 1 workload.
